command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /etc/systemd/system
tee /etc/systemd/system/chroot-web.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Chrooted web application on port 8080
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=appsvc
Group=appsvc
RootDirectory=/srv/app-chroot
WorkingDirectory=/app
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /app
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
chmod 0644 /etc/systemd/system/chroot-web.service
systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/chroot-web.service
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now chroot-web.service
systemctl is-enabled chroot-web.service
systemctl is-active chroot-web.service
systemctl --no-pager --full status chroot-web.service | sed -n '1,14p'
